title: EvoSQL: Memory-Augmented Critic-Generator Co-Evolution for Text-to-SQL
abstract: arXiv:2607.20489v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Text-to-SQL has advanced rapidly with large language models, but complex database queries still require reasoning beyond one-shot generation, including multi-step decomposition, execution-based diagnosis, and targeted correction. We present EvoSQL, a co-evolution framework that formulates SQL synthesis as an iterative interaction between a generator and a critic. EvoSQL maintains a contextualized candidate memory, verifies SQL candidates with both execution signals and LLM-based critique, and updates its memory through utility-guided aggregation. To strengthen the underlying generator-critic pair, we further introduce a Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (SDPO) fine-tuning stage that injects execution-aware supervision into modern coding LLM backbones. Experiments on Spider and BIRD show that EvoSQL consistently improves open-source models over Maj@16 baselines, with particularly large gains on BIRD-Dev, ranging from +1.37% for Qw

translated_title: EvoSQL：面向Text-to-SQL的记忆增强评论者-生成器协同进化框架
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型的发展，Text-to-SQL（文本到SQL）技术进展迅速，但复杂的数据库查询仍需要超越一次性生成的推理能力，包括多步分解、基于执行的诊断以及针对性修正。我们提出了EvoSQL，一个协同进化框架，它将SQL合成形式化为生成器与评论者之间的迭代交互。EvoSQL维护一个上下文化的候选记忆，通过执行信号与基于大语言模型的批评对SQL候选进行双重验证，并通过效用引导的聚合来更新其记忆。为了强化底层的生成器-评论者组合，我们进一步引入了自蒸馏策略优化微调阶段，向现代代码大语言模型骨干中注入执行感知的监督信号。在Spider和BIRD数据集上的实验表明，EvoSQL持续提升开源模型相对Maj@16基线的表现，其中在BIRD-Dev上的提升尤为显著，提升幅度从Qw……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: EvoSQL提出了一种将SQL生成形式化为生成器与评论者迭代交互的协同进化框架，通过维护上下文化候选记忆、结合执行信号与LLM批评进行验证，并辅以自蒸馏策略优化（SDPO）微调，显著提升了开源模型在Spider和BIRD基准上的Text-to-SQL表现。
en_tdlr: EvoSQL formulates Text-to-SQL as iterative generator-critic co-evolution with a contextualized candidate memory, dual verification via execution signals and LLM critique, and a Self-Distillation Policy Optimization fine-tuning stage, consistently improving open-source models on Spider and BIRD.
